cook.name: 🍲 Cooking Stove — Tamsin's Bakery (West) or Your Cottage (Home Island)
cook.desc: You can cook at the public stove in The Bakery (Tamsin, west of the bridge) or in the stove inside your Cottage.

bench.name: 🪵 Workbench — Pell's Carpentry (Northeast of Town)
bench.desc: Walk east from Town Square and head northeast to The Carpenter's Shop (Pell).

forge.name: ⚒️ The Forge and Anvil — Bram's Blacksmith (East of Square)
forge.desc: Walk east from Town Square past the Seed Shop to The Forge (Bram).

mill.name: 🌊 Water Mill & 🥛 Dairy — Hollin's Farm (Southvale)
mill.desc: Take the south road from Bloomshire towards Southvale and enter Hollin's Farm (West) to grind Flour, Sugar, Rice and churn Butter/Cheese.

loom.name: 🧵 Tailor Loom — Tilly's Workshop (West Bank of Town)
loom.desc: Cross the bridge west of Town Square and walk south a few steps to The Tailor's (Tilly) to weave Cloth with Wool.
